title: gatewatch: governance title claims automated workflows absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit 48a5c1c236a222d7e1751646525179c95abfeea9, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), with no workflow file changed. Article I requires PR titles/descriptions to describe their diff truthfully; the subject claims automated workflows while the diff contains only the constitution file. File: docs/CONSTITUTION.md (lines 1-142).
